# Live WAF baseline (block): tools/loadtest -variants -hardening, with the format checks refusing.
# The attack templates listed under [admitted attacks] reach the origin and the benign controls listed under
# [refused controls] are refused. Every other attack must be refused and every other control forwarded, and every
# entry must still hold: check_live_report.py fails on a change in either direction, so what is blocked now stays
# blocked. After a deliberate change, regenerate this file from the Security review run's report:
#   python3 .github/security/check_live_report.py REPORT .github/security/live-waf-baseline-block.txt --write
